name: Solid Power
verdict: FLAT — no position; named kill; three dated re-court triggers; SHORTS BARRED
recommendation: FLAT. The DAMAGE-ABSENT classification dies, but on blue's harder ground: SLDP's entire above-cash value ($119M stub over $1.838/sh net cash) is an UNPRICEABLE LICENSING OPTION — the issuer discloses capacity (45 t/yr pilot, 75 t/yr YE26 target) but has never published $/kg, capex/t, or royalty structure, and in the same quarter management LOWERED collectability on the only licensing milestones it had booked ($1.2M reversal against the SK On R&D LICENSE agreement; contract assets $7.49M -> $0). Red's revenue kill sustained with corrected arithmetic: 1H26 $2.805M vs 1H25 $13.556M = -79.3% (red's -63% was a period mismatch); street FY26 $13.02M vs our ~$4.6M = ~65% divergence, mechanism named (street annualizing a completed one-time line build) — though the consensus refresh post-8/4 is unconfirmed. Burn corrected to ~$70M/yr (~20 months stub coverage), interest income pays ~24% of theta. §BIOTECH-BASE-RATE analog honored: net cash is a depletion schedule, never a floor.
named_kill: UNPRICEABLE-PRIZE (NOVEL): a project developer whose funded prize cannot be computed from its own filings — every price/capex input must be assumed. At the issuer's own $50/kg at-scale target, justifying the stub needs ~5.3x the YE26 capacity target; clearing +50% needs ~30x.
recourt_triggers: a SIGNED, dollar-valued SK On replacement collaboration (in negotiation per transcript)
the Korea JV by YE2026 with SLDP's capex share and capacity disclosed

watch.jea_expiry: 2026-09-30 initial-phase JEA (Samsung SDI/BMW) expires — a lapse triggers NO 8-K; observability is asymmetric: a signed Phase 2 would PR. Silence past mid-October = Bayesian negative.
watch.short_bar: 13.64% SI, DISCOVERING/CROWDED-SHORT, dated JEA binary = squeeze tail — SHORTS BARRED.
watch.facility_check: plant_thermal/sentinel2 on the SP2 Thornton parcel = highest-value unrun check of 'operational start-up Q4 2026' — needs geocode resolution first.

pre_mortem: Pass-risk (unknown-unknown: negotiation state): the SK On replacement collaboration signs with a dollar value and the unpriceable option re-rates overnight.
The 9/30 JEA converts to a funded Phase 2 announced by Samsung's side first — foreign-venue disclosure our watches don't cover.
Attention cohort: solid-state narrative waves can triple this class of name without any filing at all — a miss we accept by design.
what_could_go_wrong.sentence: If this FLAT costs us, the most likely reason will be a signed SK On or Samsung Phase-2 announcement re-rating the unpriceable option overnight — the exact undisclosed strike we refused to pay seventy million a year of theta to hold.
